source_policy: Index only committed Android route evidence; host smokes remain experiment-local intermediate evidence and never become registry rows. Preserve exact model/tokenizer/quantization/workload provenance, raw per-output hashes, and null plus explicit reasons. Output sanity is a superficial exact-hash corruption/gibberish smoke check, not quality, correctness, grounding, usefulness, or acceptance.

entries.summary: Complete canonical Android CPU campaign: one first short request plus five loaded-route requests per tier, with successful slot erasure, full prefill, cache_n=0, EOS completion, and no truncation for all 16 requests.
limitations: The pinned Unsloth repository and GGUF metadata identify Unsloth, Q4_K_M, and the importance matrix but do not publish the exact converter/quantizer commit. Artifact bytes are still bound by revision, size, and SHA-256; this provenance limitation must remain visible.
Post-prefill-to-first-token timing is unavailable because llama.cpp exposes aggregate prompt timing but no alignable server-clock first-token timestamp.
Externally timed decode excludes the first generated token from both numerator and interval.
Request timings include the local WSL-to-Windows ADB forwarding path used to reach the phone-hosted server.
Sampling begins just after server process launch and can miss startup allocations or peaks shorter than the sampling interval. VmHWM is process-lifetime cumulative RSS, not isolated model/KV memory.
No calibrated external or OS energy measurement was available; battery charging state is context only.
Battery temperature rose from 37.0 °C to 44.3 °C and thermal status code rose from 0 to 3 during the campaign; medians are retained observations, not thermally normalized values.
The third-party Q4_K_M GGUF and llama.cpp CPU runtime differ from other model routes, so comparisons are route-level and not architecture-only.
Output sanity checks only exact-output corruption or gibberish; it is not quality, correctness, grounding, usefulness, or acceptance.

entries.summary: Complete canonical Android OpenCL GPU-offload campaign: one first short plus five loaded-route requests per tier on one loaded server/slot, with full slot erase, cache_n=0, full prompt evaluation, EOS, and exact provider proof for all 16 requests.
limitations: OpenCL GPU offload is mixed execution, not GPU-exclusive: CPU/CPU_REPACK model buffers and a CPU compute buffer remain; HTTP, tokenizer, sampler, scheduling/orchestration, and unsupported operations remain CPU-side.
Flash Attention is disabled because this OpenCL route does not support it; exact individual-operation OpenCL/CPU partition is unavailable.
The campaign ended at thermal status 3; battery temperature rose from 32.5 C to 42.5 C, so sustained thermal throttling likely affected later observations.
No calibrated external or OS energy measurement was available; USB charging state is context only.
Process memory sampling can miss brief peaks and does not isolate vendor-driver or GPU-private allocation; VmHWM is cumulative.
Post-prefill-to-first-token remains null because the server exposes no alignable server-clock first-token timestamp.
Output sanity is an exact-hash corruption/gibberish check, not quality or correctness.
The Unsloth Q4_K_M artifact is a third-party conversion and its exact converter revision is unpublished.
